{"consolidated_memory":"DOUBLE COUNTING IN analytics/etl/rollup.sql — TWO INCIDENTS

**First Incident [2026-06-22]**
- File: analytics/etl/rollup.sql
- Problem: Double counting in the daily rollup
- Signal: Totals larger than the source table
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #5327 on branch fix/double-counting-1
- Repro: Rerun the rollup for a day already loaded
- Result: The flaky test went from 31 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Second Incident [2026-07-22]**
- File: analytics/etl/rollup.sql
- Problem: Double counting in the daily rollup
- Signal: Totals larger than the source table
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file; manifested only on the first request after a cold start
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #7559 on branch fix/double-counting-2
- Repro: Rerun the rollup for a day already loaded
- Result: Reclaimed 11 GB of blob storage

These are two distinct bugs in the same area of analytics/etl/rollup.sql with the same symptom but different underlying causes requiring different fixes."}
